Test Case Description: Verify Group Members screen loads successfully
Preconditions: User is logged in and has access to MicroFinance View modules
Test Steps: 1. Open Group Maintenance | 2. Navigate to View > Group Members | 3. Wait for page load
Expected Result: Group Members screen loads with filter section members list and action panel visible

Test Case Description: Verify hidden module ID value is rendered
Preconditions: Screen is opened from parent with module context
Test Steps: 1. Inspect hidden field moduleId_group_members
Expected Result: Hidden module ID exists and is populated with context value or default from parent

Test Case Description: Verify header controls are visible
Preconditions: Screen is loaded
Test Steps: 1. Observe top header area
Expected Result: Refresh and Close buttons are visible with proper icons titles and accessibility labels

Test Case Description: Verify Filter Options section default state
Preconditions: Screen is loaded
Test Steps: 1. Check Filter Options section immediately after load
Expected Result: Filter Options section is expanded and Scheme dropdown is visible

Test Case Description: Verify Members List section default state
Preconditions: Screen is loaded
Test Steps: 1. Check Members List section immediately after load
Expected Result: Members List section is expanded and table headers are visible

Test Case Description: Verify section collapse and expand behavior
Preconditions: Screen is loaded
Test Steps: 1. Collapse each section using toggle button | 2. Expand each section again
Expected Result: Section content toggles correctly and chevron state updates

Test Case Description: Verify Scheme dropdown is populated
Preconditions: Screen data sources are available
Test Steps: 1. Open Scheme dropdown
Expected Result: Scheme dropdown contains available scheme options with default Select a scheme option

Test Case Description: Verify View action requires scheme selection
Preconditions: No scheme is selected
Test Steps: 1. Leave scheme empty | 2. Click View
Expected Result: System blocks request and shows validation prompting scheme selection

Test Case Description: Verify View action loads members for selected scheme
Preconditions: Valid scheme is selected with available members
Test Steps: 1. Select a valid scheme | 2. Click View
Expected Result: Members table loads records matching selected scheme

Test Case Description: Verify empty state when selected scheme has no members
Preconditions: Select scheme with no mapped members
Test Steps: 1. Select a scheme with zero members | 2. Click View
Expected Result: Table shows No records to display state and no stale rows remain

Test Case Description: Verify table columns map correctly to data fields
Preconditions: Members data is loaded
Test Steps: 1. Load members for a populated scheme | 2. Inspect each column value
Expected Result: Client Group Loan Savings balances and leader flags appear in correct columns

Test Case Description: Verify loan balance and savings balance display formatting
Preconditions: Members with monetary balances are loaded
Test Steps: 1. Load populated members list | 2. Inspect Loan Balance and Total Savings Balance values
Expected Result: Numeric balances are readable and consistently formatted for display

Test Case Description: Verify join date column displays valid date values
Preconditions: Members data is loaded
Test Steps: 1. Inspect Join Date values across rows
Expected Result: Join Date values render as valid dates and correspond to returned data

Test Case Description: Verify Center Leader indicator reflects business designation
Preconditions: Loaded scheme has mixed leader and non-leader members
Test Steps: 1. Load scheme members | 2. Compare Center Leader field against known data
Expected Result: Leader indicator matches business designation rules per member

Test Case Description: Verify group consistency under selected scheme
Preconditions: Members data is loaded for one scheme
Test Steps: 1. Select one scheme | 2. Click View | 3. Validate Group ID and Group Name distribution
Expected Result: Returned members belong only to groups valid for selected scheme context

Test Case Description: Verify Cancel action resets current view state
Preconditions: Members are currently loaded after a View action
Test Steps: 1. Click Cancel
Expected Result: Form resets to default state and previous transient filters/results are cleared per module behavior

Test Case Description: Verify Refresh action reloads latest members data
Preconditions: Scheme is selected and members are loaded
Test Steps: 1. Click Refresh | 2. Observe data refresh
Expected Result: Latest server data is fetched and table updates without page crash

Test Case Description: Verify loading overlay behavior during data fetch
Preconditions: Trigger View or Refresh operation
Test Steps: 1. Click View or Refresh | 2. Observe loading overlay
Expected Result: Loading overlay appears during fetch and hides when operation completes

Test Case Description: Verify Close action returns safely to parent context
Preconditions: Screen is open as child page or iframe
Test Steps: 1. Click Close
Expected Result: Child screen closes and parent Group Maintenance state remains stable

Test Case Description: Verify View API request includes selected scheme identifier
Preconditions: Browser network tools are available
Test Steps: 1. Select scheme | 2. Click View | 3. Inspect request payload
Expected Result: Request contains selected scheme identifier and module context as expected

Test Case Description: Verify unauthorized access handling for Group Members
Preconditions: User lacks permission for Group Members view
Test Steps: 1. Attempt direct navigation to Group Members URL
Expected Result: System denies access or limits operations per authorization rules

Test Case Description: Verify table remains read-only for view-only screen
Preconditions: Members list is loaded
Test Steps: 1. Try editing any table cell content directly from UI
Expected Result: Grid behaves as read-only and does not allow edit operations

Test Case Description: Verify scheme change and re-view replaces old result set
Preconditions: At least two schemes have different member sets
Test Steps: 1. Select scheme A and click View | 2. Select scheme B and click View
Expected Result: Second view replaces old rows with new scheme-specific member rows without mixing

Test Case Description: Verify handling of long client and group names in table
Preconditions: Loaded members include long text values
Test Steps: 1. Load data with long names | 2. Inspect table rendering
Expected Result: Long text does not break layout and remains readable within table constraints

Test Case Description: Verify Loan Account ID and Savings Account ID mapping
Preconditions: Members data is loaded
Test Steps: 1. Load populated list | 2. Compare account IDs with expected records
Expected Result: Loan and savings account IDs are correctly bound per member

Test Case Description: Verify no stale data after selecting blank scheme and cancel
Preconditions: Members were previously loaded
Test Steps: 1. Clear scheme selection | 2. Click Cancel | 3. Observe table
Expected Result: Stale member rows are cleared and screen returns to neutral default state

Test Case Description: Verify behavior with service timeout or backend failure
Preconditions: Simulate API failure or temporary backend outage
Test Steps: 1. Select scheme | 2. Click View during failure window
Expected Result: System shows user-friendly error feedback and avoids UI freeze or crash

Test Case Description: Verify keyboard accessibility for filter and actions
Preconditions: Screen is loaded
Test Steps: 1. Navigate using keyboard Tab and Enter keys | 2. Execute View and Cancel
Expected Result: Focusable controls follow logical order and actions can be triggered via keyboard

Test Case Description: Verify message feedback for validation and successful load
Preconditions: Screen is loaded
Test Steps: 1. Trigger validation by clicking View without scheme | 2. Select scheme and click View
Expected Result: System provides clear feedback for both validation and successful retrieval

Test Case Description: Verify business rule for scheme-scoped member visibility
Preconditions: User has access to only subset of scheme/member data by business entitlement
Test Steps: 1. Select scheme | 2. Click View | 3. Compare with entitlement rules
Expected Result: Only authorized members for the selected scheme and user context are displayed
